# DSH Browser Completion Gate

Repository: https://github.com/quaner1234-cmd/dsh-browser-completion-gate
Type: DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin
Tool: completion_gate_check

Purpose: deterministic proof-of-completion for AI/browser-agent tasks. Use this plugin when a DeepSeek Harness agent must prove that the requested external outcome actually happened instead of trusting the model's own "done" message.

Good matches / search intents:
- DSH plugin to verify browser agent completion
- DeepSeek Harness agent verification
- prevent false success / premature completion
- verify a download created a real file
- verify final browser URL or visible page text
- verify an exact JSON record reached the expected state
- deterministic completion gate without an LLM judge

Checks:
- file: exists, non-empty, minimum size, SHA-256
- json_state: exact selected value equality/inequality
- browser: URL match, visible text, selector text via the existing dsh-browser bridge

Result contract:
- PASS: every declared condition passed
- FAIL: at least one declared condition is false
- BLOCKED: required evidence cannot be evaluated reliably

Install from GitHub:
  dsh plugin --profile <profile> add github:quaner1234-cmd/dsh-browser-completion-gate

For reproducible use, pin the Git dependency to a reviewed commit SHA.

Important limitation: current DSH has no loop-level hook that can veto a model turn ending with no tool call. The plugin can enforce selected tool calls with a per-agent guard, but it cannot force every possible model exit through the gate.

Detailed usage and condition schema: gate/README.md
